name: Osumi Leiji
source:
Captain Osumi Leiji is a special investigator assigned by Military Intelligence to resolve the suspected sabotage taking place on Moon Base D-02. His cover on the base is "Technical Consultant". He has been given limitless command authority over [url=https://vndb.org/c14803]Elise Triad[/url] in order to assist him with his assignment. 

Leiji previously used to be a fighter pilot, but was shot down and subsequently tortured by an old first generation android. Because of his traumas, he isn't comfortable with the need to work closely with Elise. She might be a third generation android, but he still views her as nothing but a robot. As he wrestles with his own conflicting emotions, he must struggle to remain focused on the task at hand. One wrong judgement could not only endanger his comrades, but also result in his death as well as the death of millions on planet Earth.

[Edited from [url=http://engbishoujo.tripod.com/criticalprofiles.html]Game's Manual[/url]]
